changes.to: How should the Android version share the engine? The core is Swift. Options: (a) build it with the Swift SDK for Android and call it from a Kotlin InputMethodService through JNI; (b) port the core to Kotlin (two copies to keep in step); (c) rewrite the core in Rust/C++ for every platform. Recommended: (a). Also: release channel (Google Play has a one-time developer fee) and whether to install the Android SDK/emulator on this Mac (several GB) for testing.
